servizi.title: Services
servizi.description: Electronic design, STM32 firmware, CAN/LIN networks, vehicle harnesses, LED lighting, reverse engineering and testing.

items.title: Electronic design
items.text: Custom boards for control units, switch panels, steering wheels, lighting modules and interfaces. Schematics, multilayer PCB layout, 3D models for mechanical integration, production files and prototype management.

items.title: Embedded firmware
items.text: Development on STM32 microcontrollers: inputs and outputs, motor control, lighting animations, safety logic. Board bring-up, bootloaders and field updates.

items.title: CAN / LIN vehicle networks
items.text: Message and communication matrix definition, integration with existing ECUs, gateways between networks, monitoring and diagnostic tools.

items.title: Vehicle wiring harnesses
items.text: Electrical architecture, wiring diagrams, cable and protection sizing, connector selection, production and assembly documentation.

items.title: Lighting and LEDs
items.text: Functional lamps, animated lighting, LED walls and backlit surfaces for vehicles, show cars and exhibitions. Dedicated drivers, thermal and optical management.

items.title: Reverse engineering
items.text: Analysis of existing systems, communication protocol decoding, integration of series-production components into special projects.

items.title: Integration and testing
items.text: Installation on the vehicle, commissioning, fault diagnosis and support through to delivery.

metodo.title: How we work
metodo.description: Analysis, design, prototype, integration and documentation: the drme.tech method for special-vehicle electronics.

steps.title: Analysis
steps.text: We start from the project's needs and its space, time and budget constraints, and define the electrical architecture together.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: Schematics, PCBs, firmware and harnesses developed in parallel, with 3D models shared with the mechanical and design teams.

steps.title: Prototype
steps.text: Building and bench-testing boards and subsystems, with fast iterations.

steps.title: Integration
steps.text: Installation on the vehicle, functional testing and fine-tuning.

steps.title: Documentation
steps.text: Schematics, pinouts, bills of materials and assembly instructions, ready for replicas or small series.
